reasons: Type/nullability disagreements: project_id string-vs-int, is_dynamic boolean-vs-int, owner/assignee/overall_progress/assignee_imported non-nullable-vs-null.
Count-vs-rows: NOT present on preprod (info.count, count and len(rows) all agreed).

setup.why: resolve real plans with multiple linked runs, for both single-page and 2-page paging checks

item_shape.name: string
item_shape.project_id: 332537 — BARE INTEGER, not a string. Declared type is string (example "PR-17"). REPRODUCES the preprod string-vs-int mismatch.
item_shape.is_dynamic: false — CORRECTLY a boolean on prod. DOES NOT REPRODUCE the preprod is_dynamic boolean-vs-int mismatch (preprod actual was int 0); on prod every sampled row (7 across 2 plans) had a real boolean.
item_shape.overall_progress: null — declared non-nullable object per schema. REPRODUCES the preprod nullable mismatch.
item_shape.overall_progress_by_status_id: object, real rollup keyed by result_status id — matches declared {type:object}
item_shape.test_plans: [] — EMPTY on every row sampled (2 rows under plan 181340, 5 under plan 67555, 1 under plan 182865 — see cross-check below), even though every row was fetched BECAUSE it is linked to the plan being queried. The declared row schema types test_plans as an array of {id,name}; it is structurally correct (an array) but never actually carries the very plan that scoped the query. Not flagged in preprod's own analysis of this capability (preprod's declared_missing/undeclared_returned lists for get_test_plan_test_runs_v1 do not mention this field at all) — new observation.
item_shape.observability_id: string, duplicates the numeric part of observability_url and equals uuid — UNDECLARED, reproduces preprod

plan_linkage_cross_check.why: task-specific check: does get_test_plan_test_runs_v1 confirm a run is linked, and does get_test_runs_v1(include_test_plan=true) agree on the SAME run

plan_182865.name: Testing parikshit (TP-4036)

get_test_plan_test_runs_v1.result: 1 row: TR-5217429, own row-level test_plans:[] (empty, per the pattern above)

plan_182865.get_test_runs_v1_cross_check: see tests/live/runs/tm-prod/get_test_runs_v1.json — for this SAME run (TR-5217429 / uuid 72374668), get_test_runs_v1(include_test_plan=true) DOES return test_plans:[{"id":182865,"name":"Testing parikshit"}] — the two readers AGREE on the linkage (the plan reader confirms membership by list inclusion + count; the general listing shows the actual plan object). This directly CONTRADICTS the preprod-reported systemic behavior (get_test_runs_v1 returns test_plans:[] for every run, confirmed across two probes/two days on preprod). See get_test_runs_v1.json for the full writeup — this is the single most important cross-capability finding of this batch.

pagination.verdict: Count-vs-rows: clean on prod too, matching preprod. info.count, top-level count, and len(rows) all agree on every call; p=2 beyond the real data correctly returns an empty array rather than repeating page 1 or erroring. No per_page/limit param exists in the query schema (only `p`); not testable, matches preprod's own note that this route has no per_page override.

notes: PREPROD VERDICT MOSTLY REPRODUCES, with one narrowing and one new finding. Reproduces: declared_missing (type, self_ui_link), undeclared_returned (7 fields), project_id string-vs-int, overall_progress non-nullable-vs-null, count-vs-rows staying clean. DOES NOT REPRODUCE: is_dynamic came back correctly typed as boolean on every prod row sampled (preprod had it as int 0) — this specific mismatch appears to be preprod-only, narrowing preprod's DRIFT slightly on prod. NEW: this capability's own row-level `test_plans` field is empty on every row across all 3 plans probed (181340, 67555, 182865) — including rows fetched precisely because they belong to the plan being queried — so this capability never actually surfaces the plan linkage on its own rows; membership in the response list (plus the count envelope) is the only signal of linkage this capability gives. That gap is exactly what makes the cross-check with get_test_runs_v1 meaningful (see plan_linkage_cross_check above and get_test_runs_v1.json): for run TR-5217429/plan 182865, get_test_runs_v1(include_test_plan=true) DOES correctly populate test_plans with the linked plan, which is the opposite of what preprod's systemic finding predicted for that capability. That result belongs primarily to the get_test_runs_v1 file but is recorded here too because it directly answers this capability's own linkage question.
